Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI of 1983
HOUSE BUILDING
FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT), ORDINANCE 1983
ORDINANCE XXI of 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the House Building Finance Corpora tion Act, 1952
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th September, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the House Building Finance
Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Substitution of section 4, Act XVIII of 1952

ORDINANCE XXI of 1983
HOUSE BUILDING
FINANCE CORPORATION (AMENDMENT), ORDINANCE 1983
ORDINANCE XXI of 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the House Building Finance Corpora tion Act, 1952
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th September, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Substitution of section 4,
Act XVIII of 1952.-In the House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952
(XVIII of 1952), for section 4 the following shall be substituted, namely :-
"4.
Authorised capital and return payable.-(1) The authorised capital of the
Corporation shall be two hundred million rupees divided into forty fully
paid-up shares of the value of five million rupees each to be subscribed from
time to time by the Federal Government or any bank or financial institution
with the previous approval of the Federal Government :
Provided that
the Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, increase
the authorised capital to such extent in such manner as may be specified in the
notification.
(2) The Corporation shall pay to the Federal Government or
any bank or financial institution such return on the capital subscribed by the
Federal Government or the bank or financial institution under subsection (1) at
such rate as the Federal Government may, by notification in the official
Gazette, specify."
